description: Multi-engine web search capability providing formatted markdown search results and programmatic link arrays.
author: Charon Librarian

web_search_execute.description: Performs a multi-engine web search and returns formatted markdown for LLM ingestion.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return. Defaults to 5.

ignored_domains.description: Optional list of domains to filter out from search results.

web_search_links.description: Performs a web search and returns raw result objects ({title, link, snippet}) for programmatic consumption.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return. Defaults to 5.

ignored_domains.description: Optional list of domains to filter out.
